tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication @EASFCDirect
tweets.text: We have temporarily paused the Daily Login UT Consumables Pack reward due to the Packs containing non-consumable Items. Once we address the issue and resume the reward, players will receive it in-game.

tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication @EASFCDirect
tweets.text: We have removed the Opening Stadium 11v11 Event and the Opening Stadium 11v11 Event Objective in The Grounds' Clubhouse as we investigate a related issue.

tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication @EASFCDirect
tweets.text: We have identified an issue with using Emotes in The Grounds and have temporarily disabled them. We'll provide another update when available.

tweets.author: EA SPORTS FC Direct Communication @EASFCDirect
tweets.text:
We identified an issue with the Bronze League Milestones, Silver League Milestones and Gold League Milestones Objective Groups in The Grounds and have temporarily removed them from game. 

We'll provide an update when available.
